searchText: I think the original paper was a proof of concept for interest sake. We probably don't want to have a dependency on another chain like this. Solana is also more centralized than BCH as well. If we would have to engineer a fallback before doing this, that means you have 2x the work and you have to somehow be sure that your fallback will work when not using it.

excerpts.content:
I think the original paper was a proof of concept for interest sake.
We probably don't want to have a dependency on another chain like this.
Solana is also more centralized than BCH as well.
If we would have to engineer a fallback before doing this, that means you have 2x the work and you have to somehow be sure that your fallback will work when not using it.
